density_3d weight sweep - band check - 2026-08-18

Bands vs density weight

Three 500-epoch models identical to 6-no_old except the 3-D density loss weight (1 / 50 / 200; raw-MSE convention, weight 1 = normalized 1/215). Two neutral structures, non-SCF bands from the fully-ML CHGCAR (hard clamp: negatives zeroed, renormalized — required for eigensolver convergence), DFT reference reused from the 8-band campaign. Each run plotted against its own Fermi level; both Fermi levels lie at zero.

Two-case statistics: hard-clamping the weight-1 baseline already captures most of the window improvement; after clamping there is no clean window trend with weight. The absolute Fermi placement improves monotonically with weight (near-exact at 200). The 1-D potential-family metrics pay a growing cost at 50 and 200.
